name: determinants_model
description: Determinants models per model and metric: CV R² mean and SD, permutation null p, drop-one-block ΔR² with t-interval, univariate Spearman rho and AUROC (GIPPA_SPEC.md §7.8.2, §7.8.3, §9.3).

fields.name: feature_or_block
fields.description: all (whole model), a block (delta_r2) or an encoded feature column (univariate)

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower 95% confidence bound; NA when there is no interval

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper 95% confidence bound; NA when there is no interval

fields.name: n
fields.description: Rows the metric was computed on

fields.name: n_perm
fields.description: Permutations behind null_p (non-NaN null values); 0 otherwise

fields.name: flags
fields.description: ';'-joined flags: too_few_rows, unestimated, null_degenerate, null_uncalibrated, ci_unestimated
